maria (AE): Hey team — Granite (prospect) wants a quick perf POC next week. Target: 300 sustained qps, occasional bursts to 2k qps for 30s. Need latency 95p < 200ms. Can we run a realistic plan?
Sam (SE): Got it. Do they need embeddings or generation?
maria (AE): Primary conversational generation (chat completions), some embedding calls for retrieval. 70/30 gen/embed split.
sam (SE): Ok — gen dominates cost/latency. Suggest run: 10m ramp to 300 qps, 20m steady, then 6x microbursts (30s each) to 2k qps spaced ~5m apart. Capture tail 95/99/999.
jin (SRE): That pattern is fine. Two operational items: 1) warmup KV cache to avoid cold-kv tail. Run a prefix-warmup at 1x qps for 5m before main. 2) pre-warm dedicated pool or set burst policy. Spinning dedicated nodes takes ~8m.
oliver (PerfEng): Agree. Also measure cold-start vs warmed. We'll run one cycle with no cache and one with cache primed. Attached run snippet below — lightweight vegeta sequence we used:
```
echo "GET https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" > targets.txt
for i in {1..6}; do cat targets.txt >> full_targets.txt; done
vegeta attack -rate=300 -duration=20m -targets=full_targets.txt | vegeta report
# then bursts: vegeta attack -rate=2000 -duration=30s ...
```
sam (SE): Can we include realistic request sizes? Granite says avg prompt ~350 tokens, response ~180 tokens. Include those in headers/body so run reflects token cost.
jin (SRE): Also set client-side concurrency to simulate many clients, not single-threaded hammer. We'll use 400 concurrent workers for bursts.
maria (AE): Pricing question from buyer: will bursts be charged at hosted per-token rate or can we use reserved burst capacity? sales-ops?
sales-ops: If they sign a Dedicated reservation we can configure burst capacity (within committed pool or short-term overage). Practically: reserved monthly commit reduces unit cost; bursts beyond commit are charged at overage rate. We can offer a temporary burst credit for POC — ask for scope.
sam (SE): For the POC quote, please include both: hosted per-token estimate for the test and a reserved commit option with a 3-month pilot discount.
security: Quick flag — Granite's procurement requires answers on KMS and audit logs. They specifically asked: 1) KMS integration for customer keys, 2) retention window for request logs, 3) does Dedicated store model weights on customer-side only?
jin (SRE): KMS: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private/Dedicated. Logs: default retention 90 days in console, can extend with enterprise retention add-on. Models: hosted uses our managed weights; Dedicated can be configured with customer-private models if required. We'll draft a short answers doc.
oliver (PerfEng): For measurement, we'll capture: p95/p99/p999, token/sec, error-rate, queue length, and latency breakdown (network/proxy/runtime/kv). Add a small histogram export.
maria (AE): Practical asks for the ops run: who will trigger the Dedicated spinup and when?
deploy-bot: dedicated-pool-request(granite-poc): accepted -> provisioning started (eta ~8m).
jin (SRE): I'll provision and monitor. Plan: provision 1x small pool (4xA10s equivalent) for warmup + bursts. If we see sustained >80% GPU utilization, scale to 2x.
sam (SE): Test data — use synthetic user prompts based on their sample set (maria to upload). Also include an anonymized seed set for eval.
maria (AE): Uploading sample prompts to the shared folder now: https://redwood.example/drive/granite/poc-inputs
sales-ops: For pricing calc: estimate tokens: ramp+steady+bursts ~ 6M input tokens + 3.5M output tokens. I'll produce hosted vs reserved delta.
oliver (PerfEng): Quick note: include KV prefix caching config: set cache TTL to 10m for this run to mimic retrieval workload. Also test a run with no cache to show differences.
security: We'll need a short answers doc for their security questionnaire by EOD tomorrow. Jin, can you draft the KMS + logs bits?
jin (SRE): Will do. Draft by EOD and ping @security once ready.
maria (AE): Timeline: schedule run Tuesday 09:00 PST. Is that ok?
sam (SE): Works for me. I'll be on call for analysis.
jin (SRE): I'll start provisioning 20m before.
oliver (PerfEng): I'll prepare the run playbook and the vegeta scripts. Will include a `results.md` template for the buyer with graphs and cost table.
maria (AE): Awesome — last ask: can we show cost sensitivity of microbursts vs sustained? A small table would help their CFO.
sales-ops: I'll add cost sensitivity table: columns for sustained-only, occasional bursts, and fully-hosted (no commitment).
maria (AE): Thanks. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when you see this and I'll lock schedule.
sam (SE): :thumbsup:
jin (SRE): :thumbsup:
oliver (PerfEng): :thumbsup:
security: :thumbsup:
